evidence.quote: For example, the RDS end of standard support date for RDS for MySQL version 5.7 is February 29, 2024.
In this case, Amazon RDS automatically enrolls your databases in RDS Extended Support on February 29, 2024, and you can continue to run RDS for MySQL version 5.7.
Starting March 1, 2024, Amazon RDS automatically charges you for RDS Extended Support.
